title: Electromagnetic diffraction in optical systems, II. Structure of the image field in an aplanatic system
claims: Vector diffraction is the relevant foundation for high-aperture image fields.
limitations: Aplanatic homogeneous-system theory; not a proof that an unknown microscope has no aberrations.
Publisher page indexed; direct full-text access returned 403.
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：出版社书目/摘要

title: Lecture 22: Coherent and incoherent imaging
claims: Coherent imaging is linear in field; incoherent imaging is linear in intensity under the stated model.
The incoherent OTF is the autocorrelation of the coherent pupil/transfer function.
limitations: Official educational primary source; scalar idealization must be stated.
Some reproduced figures in the lecture have separate copyright restrictions; reuse requires attention to the original rights holders.

title: Experimental test of an analytical model of aberration in an oil-immersion objective lens used in three-dimensional light microscopy
claims: Refractive-index mismatch, coverslip and non-design conditions degrade 3D microscope imaging.
A physical OPD-based model is compared with experimental measurements.
limitations: Do not identify an axisymmetric model with arbitrary asymmetric aberration.
The 1991 JOSAA 8,1601 version links this 1992 version under Corrections.

title: Fast and accurate three-dimensional point spread function computation for fluorescence microscopy
claims: Bessel-series computation approximates the Gibson–Lanni integral with controlled numerical error.
A Gaussian is not an accurate description of the complete 3D fluorescence PSF.
Experimental bead conditions can differ from actual specimen imaging conditions.
limitations: Numerical model accuracy is not experimental truth.
Radially symmetric scalar model does not represent all aberrations.
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：作者托管全文

title: Lecture Notes on Wave Optics
claims: A coherent impulse response propagates field via a Fresnel integral under the stated approximation.
limitations: Fresnel approximation is paraxial; not full vector Maxwell propagation.

title: Zernike polynomials and atmospheric turbulence
claims: Zernike modes provide an orthogonal expansion of wavefront on a circular pupil; normalization and indexing conventions matter.
limitations: Original application is atmospheric turbulence, not a direct calibration of microscope objectives.
Do not import atmospheric coefficient statistics into a microscope.
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：出版社书目及论文记录

title: Bayesian-Based Iterative Method of Image Restoration
claims: Foundational Bayesian derivation of an iterative nonnegative restoration method.
limitations: A historical Bayesian derivation does not make all deconvolution algorithms Bayesian.

title: An iterative technique for the rectification of observed distributions
claims: Foundational iterative rectification/deconvolution method in statistical astronomy.
limitations: Noise likelihood, kernel and stopping still need to match the imaging application.
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：学术仓储全文

title: DeconvolutionLab2: An open-source software for deconvolution microscopy
claims: Open-source microscopy deconvolution provides multiple algorithm families and explicit implementations.
limitations: Software availability is not an accuracy guarantee or an endorsement of one algorithm for all data.
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文摘要＋作者软件

title: Richardson–Lucy algorithm with total variation regularization for 3D confocal microscope deconvolution
claims: Combining RL with TV regularization can suppress unstable oscillations while preserving edges.
limitations: Edge preservation involves a prior/penalty and can bias morphology; not assumption-free.

title: Quality assessment in light microscopy for routine use through simple tools and robust metrics
claims: Ten microscopy core facilities developed practical QC methods and MetroloJ_QC.
Metrics include PSF, illumination, chromatic alignment, drift, positioning and camera noise.
Measured/theoretical FWHM<1.5 is proposed as a practical health tolerance, not precision-kernel certification.
100 versus 175 nm beads influence high-NA measured FWHM, and off-axis bead PSFs can be asymmetric.
limitations: The paper addresses routine QC and does not certify the highest-achievable PSF accuracy of any other instrument.
Do not copy confocal numerical criteria unmodified to a wide-field setup.

title: Measuring and interpreting point spread functions to determine confocal microscope resolution and ensure quality control
claims: A detailed protocol uses fluorescent microspheres and 3D PSFs for microscope quality control.
limitations: Confocal acquisition uses excitation/detection and pinhole characteristics different from camera wide-field imaging.

title: Depth-variant maximum-likelihood restoration for three-dimensional fluorescence microscopy
claims: Depth-varying aberration can be handled through a strata-based image-formation model and EM/maximum-likelihood restoration.
limitations: This is an approximate depth-varying model, not proof of a single universal convolution kernel.

title: ASI6200 Pro Series official product specification
claims: ASI6200MM/MC Pro uses 3.76 micrometre pixels.
limitations: Effective object sampling depends on actual magnification and binning; product noise figures are not an independent calibration of an installed camera.

title: Photophysical image analysis for sCMOS cameras: Noise modelling and estimation of background parameters in fluorescence-microscopy images
claims: Camera fluorescence measurements can require a Poisson–Gaussian noise model and explicit background estimation.
limitations: This supports the general modelling issue; its calibrated sCMOS model is not automatically a calibration of another camera.

title: Deconvolution methods for mitigation of transverse blurring in optical coherence tomography
claims: 深度依赖Gaussian核
比较TSVD/Tikhonov复数据与幅值数据
RL仅用magnitude fringe data
稀疏散射实验改善范围达约两倍confocal region
limitations: 稀疏与模型近似
改善范围不等于统一判据下任意组织DOF倍率
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：作者上传全文

title: Non-iterative numerical method for laterally superresolving Fourier domain optical coherence tomography
claims: 数值反卷积补偿FD-OCT横向离焦
limitations: 本次仅核摘要，PDF访问429
不从题名推导普适超分辨能力

title: Improved lateral resolution in optical coherence tomography by digital focusing using two-dimensional numerical diffraction method
claims: 标量衍射数字重聚焦
用幅值和相位
盖玻片表面相位参考
不会恢复离焦造成照明能量损失

文中未完整包括散斑及Gaussian照明传播

title: Interferometric synthetic aperture microscopy
claims: 相干逆散射计算重建
傅里叶空间覆盖与离焦表观模糊不同
limitations: 本次原论文摘要与O08后续全文交叉核对
要求相干数据和散射模型

title: Spatially deconvolved optical coherence tomography
claims: B-scan分2400子图
局部实测PSF与RL
横向改善3.1µm、轴向4.5µm
limitations: 本次仅摘要
输入幅值或平方强度需复现时全文核实
数字不是DOF倍率

多焦位实现大深度高横向分辨
limitations: 增加采集与配准
非单次离焦图像反卷积

title: Automatic estimation of point-spread-function for deconvoluting out-of-focus optical coherence tomographic images using information entropy-based approach
claims: 熵选择Gaussian核与RL
微球/洋葱/人体指尖例证
作者明确不包括衍射与相干散射
limitations: 经验非负近似
模拟乘性speckle不是完整相干模型

title: Computational adaptive optics for broadband optical interferometric tomography of biological tissue

CAO联合ISAM
越离焦相位稳定要求越苛刻

claims: 复信号数字传播
以熵自动选择传播距离

title: Speckle-constrained variational methods for image restoration in optical coherence tomography
claims: 信号相关散斑约束+PSF+BM3D型变分先验
人体皮肤原始数据
指出log域简单AWGN不可直接扩展反卷积
limitations: 本次仅摘要
具体保真公式未核实不应代写

title: Convolutional dictionary learning for blind deconvolution of optical coherence tomography images
claims: 复A-line盲去卷积
复一维轴向核
稀疏约束抑制旁瓣，权重缓解组织亮度损失

title: Theoretical analysis of performance limitation of computational refocusing in optical coherence tomography
claims: 横向采样与共焦损失约束
点扫描和空间相干全场差异
数值重聚焦无法恢复未收集光能

title: Phase-retrieved pupil functions in wide-field fluorescence microscopy
claims: 由实测3D PSF估计有效2D光瞳，并把已知折射率失配像差加入光瞳以预测PSF。
作者模拟反卷积中，恢复光瞳生成的核可达到与直接实测核相近的表现。
limitations: 这里的光瞳是所测系统的有效光瞳，不自动等于纯物镜或OCT收发光瞳。
本轮读取出版社Summary与文献信息，未读取全部付费正文。

title: Characterization of spatially varying aberrations for wide field-of-view microscopy
claims: 多离焦强度图可以恢复视场中多个位置的有效复光瞳。

本轮读取出版社摘要，未获取完整付费正文。

title: Point spread function in interferometric scattering microscopy (iSCAT). Part I: aberrations in defocusing and axial localization
claims: 矢量iPSF模型包含界面几何像差、传播/Gouy相位与粒子材料散射相位，作者结合实验和FDTD验证。

title: Wavefront measurement using computational adaptive optics
claims: 点扫描OCT点响应由照明和回收复场相乘，横向传递函数为对应光瞳卷积。
CAO校正相位与单程光瞳相位一般不是直接相同或简单两倍关系。
作者比较渐近、逆自卷积和直接前向模型估计，高阶像差出现串扰。
limitations: 建模以单散射、局部系统和所述采样/近似为前提。
在不同傅里叶和互易场约定中，符号和共轭必须一致。

title: Stability in computed optical interferometric tomography (Part I): Stability requirements
claims: 数值离焦和像差补偿的相位稳定要求由数学分析、仿真和实验评估。
关键量是某一点被扫描光束探测期间的interrogation time。
limitations: 不能把幅值图稳定视为相对相位已经稳定。
本轮全文网页遇反爬，核验原始摘要和interrogation time相关索引段落。
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：摘要及索引段落核验

title: Computational adaptive optics in phase-unstable optical coherence tomography
claims: SHARP采用短范围稳相与依次一维像差修正，在二维相位不稳定的SS-OCT中实现可分离像差补偿。
所需条件包括Nyquist采样和足够小的复幅值运动变化。
limitations: 只对可分离像差适用，不处理任意随机相位损坏。
文中摘要4 z_R与末段5 z_R存在表述差异，不能将其自动改写为普适4或5倍焦深。

title: Ultrahigh-resolution, high-speed, Fourier domain optical coherence tomography and methods for dispersion compensation

limitations: 本轮核验题名、作者、DOI与公开索引，未成功获取完整正文；不凭该来源给出本文未核实的性能数字。

title: Microscope Objectives: Types, Correction Classes & Applications
claims: 厂家说明物镜按具体规格、用途和物理约束设计，像质取决于正确选型和使用条件。

title: High precision wavefront control in point spread function engineering for single emitter localization
claims: 在特定带SLM的荧光系统校准中，作者报告30分钟内小于20 mλ的波前控制，并通过矢量PSF拟合微球栈恢复像差。
limitations: 这是特定设备、指标和时间窗，不是所有PSF测量的通用最高精度，也不能认证其他装置的水平。
evidence_level_zh: 原始论文：作者摘要核验

title: Image formation theory of optical coherence tomography with optical aberrations and its application to computational aberration correction
claims: 提出含像差的OCT成像理论及仿真方法，对双光瞳、宽谱、近轴/窄带近似和多深度CAC作区分。
其NAeff0.2、中心波长1.05µm特定仿真中，±100µm离焦区间Strehl高于0.8；该数字不是一般装置的焦深拓展倍数。
